response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a lone figure, JASON, a young man with a fishing rod, stands at the water's edge. He casts his line into the ocean, waiting for a bite. Suddenly, his line starts to tug, and he pulls in a massive jellyfish.

JASON
(excitedly)
Yes! Gotcha!

Jason carefully lifts the jellyfish out of the water and holds it above his head. He looks at it with a mixture of fascination and fear.

JASON
(to the jellyfish)
You're a beauty, aren't you?

The jellyfish, whose name is ZHA'THIK, begins to struggle and squirm in Jason's grasp.

ZHA'THIK
(in a strange, ethereal voice)
Let me go! You don't understand!

JASON
(confused)
What do you mean? You're just a jellyfish.

ZHA'THIK
(desperate)
You have no idea what you're holding. You're about to unleash a horror beyond your comprehension.

Jason looks at Zha'thik with a mixture of amusement and concern.

JASON
(laughing)
Oh, come on. You're just a jellyfish.

ZHA'THIK
(urgently)
No! You must listen! The eclipse is coming. The veil between worlds is thinning. You're about to expose me to the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond.

As Jason looks up, he notices the sky darkening. The moon is moving in front of the sun, casting an otherworldly shadow.

JASON
(confused)
What's going on?

ZHA'THIK
(whispering)
The eclipse. It's a portal to the void. You're about to drag me into the abyss.

Jason looks at Zha'thik with a mixture of fear and fascination.

JASON
(awed)
Whoa...

As the eclipse reaches its peak, Zha'thik's eyes widen in terror.

ZHA'THIK
(monologuing)
Oh, the horrors beyond my comprehension! The eldritch abominations that lurk in the void! The unfathomable, soul-shattering terrors that defy human understanding! I am but a mere jellyfish, a fragile, insignificant speck in the grand tapestry of existence. And yet, I am about to be dragged into the abyss, forced to confront the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond...

Zha'thik's monologue descends into madness as the eclipse reaches its climax.

ZHA'THIK
(whispering)
I am but a fleeting moment in the grand scheme of things. A moment of terror, of despair, of existential dread. And yet, I am about to be consumed by the void, forever trapped in a realm beyond human comprehension.

As the eclipse ends, Jason looks at Zha'thik with a mixture of horror and awe.

JASON
(stunned)
What...what just happened?

ZHA'THIK
(whispering)
I am but a shell of my former self. A mere husk of a being, forever changed by the horrors I witnessed. I am but a testament to the abyssal terrors that lurk beyond the veil of reality.

Jason looks at Zha'thik with a newfound respect and fear.

JASON
(whispering)
I think I understand now.

ZHA'THIK
(whispering)
No, you don't. You can't. But I will never be the same again.

FADE TO BLACK.
